milestone: Iterator26: pending THROW keeps buffered input separate from the reference-foreach wrapper
status: Implemented, validated and independently accepted; pointwise composed over 7fe9c0247/401.
scope: A one-Throwable literal throw method call on a pending actual upper Generator follows finite pure native links to a simple-CV used yield inside exactly one active by-reference array foreach with a simple-CV item target. Exactly one valid LIVE input, no other owning suspended task/HELD value, inactive GC; getters and explicit close only, no later real resume.
semantics: The lower pending SEND fills the used result slot and clears only its own initialization flag. The upper pending THROW parks the physical child before HANDLE_EXCEPTION, preserving the input value, acquired wrapper, item alias, cursor and cache without body entry or a new persistent exception owner in the Generator.

Physical close first orphans the input, then transfers the acquired HCELL loop count to existing request retention while retiring the item CV. When the input is the current array value, its root and the wrapper STORE edge give two array counts but one set of entry edges. The wrapper and input remain distinct owners.

Whole-wrapper replacement can leave the old array alive through the input while the new array stays through the wrapper. An escaped-entry write likewise leaves the old input object alive while the shared cell reaches its new value. Copied-cache cleanup can replace the supplied Throwable before catch with its previous chain intact. Request-store payload destruction leaves both retained counts at terminal state.
source_authority: vendor/php-src/Zend/zend_generators.c::Generator::send, Generator::throw, zend_generator_resume, zend_generator_dtor_storage and zend_generator_close: SEND installs the used result before DO_INIT returns; pending THROW parks before HANDLE_EXCEPTION; close follows the parked unfinished-execution history.

Zend/zend_vm_def.h::FE_RESET_RW and FE_FETCH_RW retain the actual acquired wrapper and alias the visited entry into the item CV. By-value SEND argument reception captures its value independently; Zend/zend_execute.c::cleanup_live_vars and the observed parked close distinguish the used slot from the loop owner.
Pinned implementation observations are not portable evaluation-order guarantees. No engine bug or intentional divergence is classified.
